datasets.name: Authored numerical tasks
datasets.scope: Deterministic authored XOR, line/noise, clusters, small graph and interaction fixtures; generated dimensions recorded per fixture.
datasets.license: Original teaching fixtures; attach project license when implemented.
datasets.split_policy: Generate independent train/dev/test draws or a declared fixed hand example; never report four XOR points as a broad benchmark.
datasets.preprocessing: Defined units and known signal/noise; expose seed/noise as data properties only when implemented.
leakage_risks: Generator may make the task unrealistically easy.
Do not reuse a hand-calculation fixture as independent empirical evidence.

datasets.name: UCI Iris
datasets.scope: 150 examples, 4 numeric measurements, 3 species; bundled sklearn loader is the planned local route.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 shown on first-party UCI page; retain attribution.
datasets.split_policy: Fixed stratified holdout plus training-only selection; small sample uncertainty explicitly reported.
datasets.preprocessing: Train-only scaling for applicable methods; no need to invent missingness.
leakage_risks: Repeated benchmark familiarity and very small classes can overstate confidence.
Dataset revision differences in a few values need a recorded loader/version.

datasets.name: UCI Wine
datasets.scope: 178 examples, 13 chemical features, 3 source classes; not Wine Quality.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 shown on UCI page.
datasets.split_policy: Fixed stratified holdout; training-fold preprocessing; clusters fitted without withheld labels.
datasets.preprocessing: Standard/robust scaling comparison with recorded training statistics.
leakage_risks: Do not use labels to choose clusters while calling the full procedure unsupervised.
Very small data is not an industrial performance benchmark.

datasets.name: UCI Wine Quality, red/white variants
datasets.scope: Two separate CSVs, 11 physicochemical inputs and ordered quality rating. Portal headline 4898 refers to white, not all rows.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 shown on UCI page.
datasets.split_policy: Declare one variant as initial task; group exact/near duplicates before splitting. A red-to-white shift study must be separate from iid evaluation.
datasets.preprocessing: Preserve rating units; train-only feature preparation; define a separate task if binarizing ratings.
leakage_risks: Pooling red/white without identity can conceal a domain factor.
Do not alter rating thresholds after seeing test scores.
Inspect duplicate feature/label rows.

datasets.name: UCI Bike Sharing
datasets.scope: 2011–2012 Capital Bikeshare hourly and daily files; choose one granularity. UCI headline reports 17389 instances; commonly described hour.csv has 17379. Resolve actual bytes/counts at preparation.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 shown on UCI page.
datasets.split_policy: Sort by timestamp, use forward development and a later fixed test period; state horizon and information availability; maintain gaps according to lag/target overlap.
datasets.preprocessing: Target cnt; exclude casual and registered; do not use instant as a meaningful numeric demand feature without a declared design. Calendar and target-time weather have different availability.
leakage_risks: casual+registered=cnt.
Observed target-time weather is not automatically a future forecast input.
Hourly/daily files cover the same activity; pooling double-counts it.
Missing hours and count discrepancy must be audited, not silently patched.

datasets.name: scikit-learn bundled Optical Digits subset
datasets.scope: Bundled 1797-example 8×8, intensity 0–16 subset, distinct from UCI full 5620 examples and original 3823/1797 split.
datasets.license: UCI source displays CC BY 4.0; retain original citation plus bundled-loader provenance.
datasets.split_policy: Fixed stratified train/dev/test within the selected bundled scope for a small educational benchmark. This is not automatically the original writer-disjoint protocol.
datasets.preprocessing: Flatten for linear/MLP; reshape [B,1,8,8] for CNN; fixed division by 16 or train-fitted transform, clearly declared.
leakage_risks: Do not mix full-release and bundled-subset scores.
No known writer IDs means no claim of newly verified writer-disjoint splitting.

datasets.name: Fashion-MNIST
datasets.scope: 60000 official training and 10000 official test images; 28×28 grayscale; 10 clothing labels.
datasets.license: Original project displays MIT license; retain exact notice and citation with download receipts.
datasets.split_policy: Reserve official test; derive development from official training only. Fix stratified subset IDs for pilot comparisons; label pilot versus full-data results.
datasets.preprocessing: Scale pixels by 255; fit any extra normalization only on fitting data. Flatten for linear/MLP and use spatial tensors for CNN; evaluate deterministic transforms.
leakage_risks: Do not tune on official test.
Pilot sampling must be identical across compared methods.
Public benchmark familiarity is not deployment validation.

datasets.name: UCI SMS Spam Collection
datasets.scope: Portal reports 5574 messages; commonly distributed file descriptions vary. Count and duplicate-group audit required before declaring a dataset size.
datasets.license: UCI page displays CC BY 4.0; original-source composition and personal-content handling still need review.
datasets.split_policy: Group exact/near duplicate texts before stratified split; fit vocabulary inside training folds.
datasets.preprocessing: Count/TF-IDF baseline; redact display/logging of phone numbers, links and personal content; do not alter evaluation inputs silently without a versioned task change.
leakage_risks: Personal details and offensive content.
Repeated templates cross split boundaries.
Contact metadata shortcuts.

datasets.name: Stanford SST-2
datasets.scope: Optional future sentence-sentiment corpus; no approved preparation.
datasets.license: Accessed owner card says unknown; do not infer reuse clearance from availability.
leakage_risks: Unresolved license.
Phrase/source grouping and test label availability require review.

datasets.name: CIFAR-10
datasets.scope: Original page describes 50000 train/10000 test 32×32 RGB images; no approved preparation.
datasets.license: This inspection did not resolve explicit dataset reuse terms on the original page; clarify before adding a distributable prepared asset.
datasets.split_policy: Official test remains reserved if later admitted.
leakage_risks: Rights clarification.
More compute is unnecessary for the first comparative course.
